# InditexTech Karate Tools

## InditexTech Karate Tools

- [InditexTech Karate Tools](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/): A toolkit to initialize, configure, generate and run Karate REST test suites.

## Documentation

- [About Karate Tools](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/about/): What Karate Tools is, who it is for, and why it exists.
- [Additional information](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/additional-information-overview/): Karate Tools changes, versions, support, and contact information.
- [Karate Tools architecture](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/architecture/): How Karate Tools is built: its modules, and how they fit together.
- [Contributing](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/contributing-overview/): How to contribute to Karate Tools.
- [Development](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/development/): Set up a development environment and work on Karate Tools.
- [Prerequisites](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/prerequisites/): What you need before you start using Karate Tools.
- [Quickstart](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/quickstart/): Scaffold and run your first Karate module in minutes.
- [Step by step](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/contributing/step-by-step/): A step-by-step guide to contributing to Karate Tools.
- [Guides](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/guides/overview/): Step-by-step guides to accomplish specific tasks with Karate Tools.
- [Reference](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/reference/overview/): Reference material for Karate Tools: configuration properties and options.
- [Karate Tools Migration Guide](/karatetools-oss/prerelease/main/release-notes/migration-guide/)
